signing_key.description: The PEM-encoded RSA private key used to sign CodePush updates. Optionally encrypted with `signing_key_passphrase`.

signing_key_passphrase.description: The passphrase to decrypt `signing_key`, if it is encrypted. Omit for an unencrypted key.

name.description: A name to identify the signing key. 3-50 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens, underscores and periods. Defaults to `Signing key`.
